name: Nikaidou Reina
source:
A mature and beautiful maid who serves Daiya's family. She's cool as a cucumber, and single-mindedly dedicated to her craft. Having served as a maid since she was a child, she's essentially family as far as her employers are concerned. She's affectionately been nicknamed "Ogress" by Daiya thanks to her sometimes strict tendencies.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4838460/HimaNatsu_Of_Churches_Sunflowers_and_Long_Summers/]Steam[/url]]
